audit.whatIsWrong: Only Ki Burst is ever named — Broken Wings, Valor, Blade of the Exile and Runic Blade appear on the page as 'her three Q dashes', 'E shield-dash' and 'her R execute'. No cooldown is given for the ability the whole page tells you to track.
audit.why: Ki Burst is 260 range on 11/10/9/8/7s — that is the number that decides when you may step up, and it was missing. Broken Wings is three casts on a 13s cooldown with the third knocking back, and Valor is a short step that blocks incoming damage, so she has four movement inputs to dodge a single 14s hook.
audit.corrected: Ki Burst is down 11s at rank 1 — that is your step-up window. Broken Wings gives three dashes on 13s and Valor a fourth, so never throw Dredge Line on cooldown.

audit.why: Riven's R is flagged projectile — that is Wind Slash, the single ranged attack Blade of the Exile grants. Nothing on the page claims otherwise, and no blocking interaction applies from Nautilus's side, so nothing was written.
45.45% over 22 games; TRICKY / 7.5 is fair for a lane you win at 2-3 and lose after.

edits.before: By Levels 4-5 her three Q dashes and E shield-dash let her cancel your Q and burst you between your CC, flipping the lane.
edits.after: By 4-5 Broken Wings' three dashes and Valor's damage block dodge the hook and she bursts you between CC casts.

edits.before: At 6 your R is undodgeable but single-target; her own R execute, W stun, and shield-dash mean she wins the all-in if your Q misses.
edits.after: At 6 Depth Charge is undodgeable but single-target; Blade of the Exile plus Ki Burst wins her the all-in if the hook misses.

edits.before: Level 1 is roughly even — you have no all-in without W or E, but your passive root makes the first auto-trade favorable, so weave a Staggering Blow auto if she walks up to last-hit. Your real window is Levels 2-3: once W (shield + splash burn) and E (slow) are up, your short trades out-damage her, and a clean Q pull into the passive root locks her for a guaranteed combo. The catch is the Q — she has three dashes and an E shield-dash to cancel it, so never throw Dredge Line on cooldown. Bait a dash first, then pull her when she's committed.
edits.after: Level 1 is roughly even — you have no all-in without W or E, but your passive root makes the first auto-trade favourable, so weave a Staggering Blow auto if she walks up to last-hit. Your real window is Levels 2-3: once Titan's Wrath and Riptide are up your short trades out-damage her, and a clean pull into the root locks her for the full combo. The catch is the hook — Broken Wings gives her three dashes on 13s and Valor a fourth, so never throw Dredge Line on cooldown. Bait a dash, then pull once she has committed.

edits.before: This is where it tilts against you. By Levels 4-5 her Q-stacks and E shield are reliable enough that she steps inside your cooldown windows and bursts you between CC casts. Your W shield helps you survive, but you can't kill her — she just W-stuns, dashes out, and resets. At 6 your R is undodgeable lockdown, but it's a single target and she has her own R execute plus a shield-dash to disengage; if you open with a whiffed Q, your R alone won't finish her. Save your full chain for when she commits, and look to call a gank rather than solo her.
edits.after: This is where it tilts against you. By Levels 4-5 Broken Wings stacks and Valor's block are reliable enough that she steps inside your cooldowns and bursts you between CC casts. Titan's Wrath keeps you alive but never kills her — she Ki Bursts, dashes out and resets. Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1, and that gap is your only honest step-up. At 6 Depth Charge is undodgeable lockdown but single-target, and Blade of the Exile still answers it, so save the chain for her commit and call a gank instead.

edits.before: Bait and dodge your Q with one of her three Q dashes or E shield-dash, leaving you cooldown-locked
edits.after: Dodge the hook with a Broken Wings dash or Valor's step, leaving you on a 14s cooldown
